raw_segments.text: The landlord brought in a new, unopened pack and informed Midia that the girls were getting
ready and that the Jews with the symbols would most likely be here soon, but the cart with
the provisions had not yet arrived.
Midia jumped up from the table and ran into the next room to give orders, but only three
girls had arrived and Maria was not there yet, and he did not know himself what orders
to give and why he had run out.
He only told them to take out of the box the presents for the girls, the sweets, the toffee
And vodka for Andri, vodka for Andri, he cried in haste.
